cohort: 263 neonates with culture-confirmed early-onset sepsis (191 GBS, 72 E. coli) from Italian prospective surveillance cohort data (2003-2022)
finding: Neonates exposed to active IAP who remained asymptomatic in the first 6 hours of life were less likely to be infected, suggesting that antimicrobial susceptibility, rather than duration of IAP, is key in preventing early-onset sepsis.
